---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new rewrite rule, provider, or capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Motivation

What optimization or workflow is not currently supported, and why does it matter?

## Proposal

What you would like the tool to do. For a new **proven rewrite rule**, please
describe:

- The primitive op sequence and the fused form it maps to.
- The side conditions that make the rewrite mathematically sound (attributes,
  initializer relationships, dtype/shape constraints, opset range).
- Whether it is domain-standard or a custom-domain op.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you are using today.
